title: An interactive deep learning-based approach reveals mitochondrial cristae topologies.
summary: Applied to 135 control and 324 OPA1-deficient mitochondria, the microscopy analysis identified tubular cristae in mouse fibroblasts and characterized OPA1-associated crista ultrastructure. The finding is limited to the studied cell contexts and model-supported microscopy analysis.
ai_technology: UNet++ segmentation with PHILOW and human proofreading

evidence.tested: Applied to 135 control and 324 OPA1-deficient mitochondria, the microscopy analysis identified tubular cristae in mouse fibroblasts and characterized OPA1-associated crista ultrastructure.
evidence.unknown: The finding is limited to the studied cell contexts and model-supported microscopy analysis.
evidence.ai_role: The authors used UNet++ and iterative proofreading in PHILOW to segment mitochondrial structures in volume electron microscopy and quantify cristae topology.
